verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents pull-request code review, Gitea Actions CI, branch handling, and general permission management and access control lists. None of it describes protected branches, protected tags, required approvals, or required passing status checks before merge. Those items are adjacent features, not the rule-based merge gating this story asks for, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can protect branches and tags with rules requiring reviews and passing checks before merge
